catalogueScope.scope: Reviewed exact catalogue bytes and version-specific integration; rc.3 accepted on macOS locally and Linux at the recorded commit. Not general business-health certification.

sourceContext.scope: Unpublished 0.1.8 UI, P1 recovery/drafts and P2 redaction/authentication/list/sampling hardening in current source. Version remains 0.1.7; publication fields describe historical published 0.1.7 only.

publication.artifactMatch: npm dist.integrity and dist.shasum equal the accepted archive, whose sha256 6e98965fb7c1658300e522247ff48039520b0388ce9ac796103cec8204477168 is the one listed in RELEASE-VERIFICATION.json and SHA256SUMS.
publication.scope: Registry and release existence plus archive identity only. Not a claim that 0.1.7 is installed on any profile, that the panel renders, or that any plugin judgement was accepted; each remains a separate verification.

history.scope: Historical 0.1.7 release and UI P1 acceptance records, upstream state and earlier pointers. Does not certify this unpublished P2 candidate.

limitations: Static checks, catalogue registration and bounded business samples do not certify all business behavior.
Private execution profiles are not OS sandboxes; account/model execution needs its own authorization.
CI applies to the exact GitHub commit; formal publication must use the accepted archive.

upstreamStatus20261025.scope: GitHub issue/PR states refreshed on 2026-10-25 only; maintainer notes remain historical. No source-handler, npm-method or real-install acceptance.

market932.remaining: Maintainer confirmed 1.66.43 adds full-packument fallback; warning or safe failure when both lookups fail remains a separate change.

store22.remaining: Await a usable npm installation method, then verify a fresh install.

ui018P2Local20261026.scope: Local macOS arm64 only. Synthetic fixtures, not general plugin business certification. No remote CI, publication or Windows claim. Existing Card/Fold/component styles retained.
ui018P2Local20261026.baselineCopy: Separate missing, first-saved, incomplete, preview and retained-history messages; persistence policy unchanged.
ui018P2Local20261026.subscription: One report chain per route/target; pause and abort without visible subscribers or in hidden document; coalesced force refresh, metadata reuse, target isolation and late response rejection.

rendering.readOnlyDisclosures: Unmount when closed; format only opened page.
rendering.forms: Mount at first opening, retain on collapse.
rendering.auxiliary: Initialize near viewport, retain visited editors; memoize stable report-derived work.

delivery.kernel: Three thin re-exports share host implementations; remove CLI/browser-only modules; retain full browser validation, MIT notices, host React and independent archive execution.

sizes.method: npm pack; unpacked/file counts from npm manifest; client gzip=Node zlib.gzipSync default options. Baselines rebuilt from immutable commits with real prepack. 3a5075 unpacked size matches published 0.1.7. Current version remains 0.1.7, unpublished.

syntheticPerformance.scope: Synthetic persistent-hook harness using the actual generated clients. Elements are rendered host-element trees, not browser layout. Mean render time is diagnostic, not a timing gate or user-perceived latency.

ui018P2Local20261026.independentReview: Fresh-context read-only review found no blocking defects or new critical verification gaps.

ui018P1RecoveryLocal20261027.scope: Local macOS arm64, unpublished working tree based on c1fed46. Existing UI architecture preserved; no remote CI, publication or Windows claim.
regressions: Cold/forced hung host service reports failure, retains prior report/baseline and recovers; ignored-abort late compute cannot publish or commit.
Client deadline covers fetch and JSON decoding, coalesced retry and lifecycle cancellation.

Dirty drafts retain original context and finding across revision/context/unavailable data; stale saves disabled, explicit copy/discard, late context and same-context revision responses cannot clear drafts.
Final review fixes: synchronous lifecycle/generation fence after asynchronous freshness check; empty, non-Error and unreadable rejection reasons cannot become success or leave a request pending.
ui018P1RecoveryLocal20261027.limits: Drafts are in-memory for the mounted page session; no automatic migration or persistence across page reload. Per-flight report deadline, at most three rounds for continually changing input; client independently bounds its whole request. Ignored cancellation cannot forcibly stop arbitrary host promises, but late results are discarded.

ui018P2HardeningLocal20261027.scope: Local macOS arm64 and DSH0.2.1-rc.3 only, candidate based on54f719c; no remote CI, release, older-host auth rerun or Windows/Linux-browser certification.
ui018P2HardeningLocal20261027.redaction: Quoted/single/nested/case/escaped/unicode/entity labelled credentials hide the whole description; CLI share output matches panel preview/copy; safe identity/location retained. No universal or raw-JSON redaction claim.

auth.expiryClock: Controlled synchronous +31 days in owned test fixture, restored immediately

syntheticHarness.scope: Actual generated client in hook harness; not browser layout/latency.

sampling.scope: Names, identity, wanted and metadata counted; skipped services unknown, unrelated captured evidence retains coverage. No native-reflection/ctx.get preemption or intermediate RSS guarantee.

ui018P2HardeningLocal20261027.review: One independent read-only review; aggregate sampling finding reproduced then fixed via RED/GREEN global bytes/count/properties/time and scoped-coverage regressions, followed by fullsuite.

scope: Default-suite counts from the supplied TAP log; fixtures means test/fixtures/**, other includes support and production files. Optional profiles depend on local inputs. Dated acceptance summaries are preserved, not rerun by this script; detailed history stays in Git.
